calculation.description: Ranks assets higher when their recent five-session loss is large relative to their trailing 20-session daily volatility, providing a risk-normalized short-term reversal signal. All inputs are lagged through the prior completed session at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: The available valid observations are concentrated in the current 2026 segment; the small effective date count and strong overlap with unscaled reversal require conservative interpretation and deterministic library-correlation audit.
